page.description: FydeOS editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: A Chromium-OS-based desktop system from Fyde Innovations, built on the openFyde project, with Android and Linux app support and separate PC builds per graphics generation.
pros: Chromium OS base with Android and Linux app support.
PC builds split by GPU generation, so older Intel machines are covered.
Also ships for single-board computers and virtual machines.
cons: PC images ship as ZIP archives containing raw .bin disk images.
Some models need the vendor's own recovery or firmware steps.
The system is tied to the FydeOS account and store for Android apps.
ROMinit pins no image here, because the current media is a ZIP archive.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for FydeOS; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: FydeOS for PC is published as a ZIP holding a raw disk image; unzip, rename the .bin to .img if the writer asks, and write it to a stick. ROMinit pins no archive here.
